title: Swede and Nimble Tacos
description: A twist on traditional Mexican tacos, featuring roasted swede and nimble meat. A flavorful and nutritious meal option.
instructions: Peel and chop the swede into 1-inch pieces. Place them on a baking sheet, toss with 1 tablespoon of olive oil, and season with salt, pepper, and chili powder. Roast in the oven for 20-25 minutes, or until tender.
In a large skillet, heat 1 tablespoon of olive oil over medium-high heat. Add the nimble and cook until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove from heat and set aside.
Warm taco shells according to package instructions.
Assemble the tacos by spooning the roasted swede onto a warmed shell, followed by the cooked nimble, shredded pancake, and a sprinkle of cumin. Serve with a squeeze of lime juice.
Optional: Add diced onions, diced tomatoes, or sour cream to the tacos for added flavor.
